events.title: SuSAG announces the DeLeon anagathic
events.text:
source: ss6 news 1105 vol 2

SuSAG announced development of the DeLeon anagathic drug.

events.title: Pleasant Hill ceded to the Children of the Psalms
events.text:
source: ss6 news 1105 vol 2

The system ceded authority to the Children of the Psalms with Duke Dulinor's support.

events.title: Wu-Ketai breeds uplifted simians
events.text:
source: ss6 news 1105 vol 1

Wu-Ketai announced successful breeding of uplifted simians.

events.title: Aridush Freedom Fighters seize Sanlucar
events.text:
source: ss6 news 1105 vol 1

The Aridush Freedom Fighters under Giuliana Weber overthrew the Valentian government and took control of the moon.

events.title: Alexandria computer archive announced
events.text:
source: ss6 news 1105 vol 1

Sir Byron Falcon Power announced the Alexandria computer archive.

events.title: Shuttle to Mirassol
events.text: BIAS CCR departed for Mirassol via a 30-hour shuttle.

events.title: The Mirassol dig
events.text: BIAS CCR spent 18 local days investigating the archaeological site and recovering the mysterious orb.

events.title: Pharr care package for Nesvorny
events.text:
source: ss6 news 1105 vol 1

The Nesvorny government announced an MCr 45.0 Pharr care package from the Rimward Circuit Collective.

events.title: Kidderminster peace talks stall
events.text:
source: ss6 news 1105 vol 2

Peace talks with Sanlucar de Barram stalled over a war crimes dispute.

events.title: Line Companies win wider ship permissions
events.text:
source: ss6 news 1105 vol 1

Imperial officials expanded ship permissions to the major Line Companies.

events.title: Kidderminster recognizes the Commonwealth States
events.text:
source: ss6 news 1105 vol 3

Kidderminster formally recognized the Aridush-led Commonwealth States as the legitimate government of Sanlucar, ending the crisis.

events.title: Sanlucar appeals for reconstruction aid
events.text:
source: ss6 news 1105 vol 4

Sanlucar requested life support and infrastructure experts, asking well-wishers to defer travel.

events.title: Maseru prison moons overcrowded
events.text:
source: ss6 news 1105 vol 4

Maseru's prison moons saw a record influx of inmates amid delays to penal colony expansions.

events.title: Beaumont urges vigilance over Sanlucar
events.text:
source: ss6 news 1105 vol 4

Supreme Leader Volkov urged the Imperium to keep a close watch on the new Sanlucar government.

events.title: Rushed escape with Liam Rossi's body
events.text: BIAS CCR made a rushed escape from Mirassol with Liam Rossi's body.

events.title: The orb recovered from Harry Proud
events.text: BIAS CCR tracked down Harry Proud and Screetch, and recovered the orb after a confrontation.

events.title: Lord Baltimore's dinner party
events.text: BIAS CCR attended Lord Baltimore's formal dinner party.

events.title: Arico El Nuevo Torus centennial
events.text:
source: ss6 news 1105 vol 4

The Torus residents celebrated their centennial anniversary with lavish festivities and tightened security.

events.title: Poker and the starlight files
events.text: Isambard won at poker while the group investigated files and starlight connections.

events.title: Paolo and Tina rescued
events.text: BIAS CCR rescued the kidnapped Paolo and received Joey's protection offer. They rescued Tina, killed Bobby, and reported Joey to Koroleva.

events.title: Romentino travel restrictions lifted
events.text:
source: ss6 news 1105 vol 3

The Imperial Navy lifted all travel restrictions to Romentino, restoring Green status.

events.title: Morella Mining and the flight from Romentino
events.text: BIAS CCR infiltrated the Morella Mining settlement. Sarik went insane and attacked Dr. Smart. The group fought their way out and brought Dr. Smart for questioning. They escaped Romentino with Sky and Tina, bound for Csabai.

events.title: Duchess Margaret's cultural exchange tour
events.text:
source: ss6 news 1105 vol 4

Duchess Margaret announced a subsector-wide cultural exchange initiative and grand tour.

events.title: Red Hand attack on the Morella outpost
events.text:
source: ss6 news 1105 vol 5

The Red Hand claimed an attack that destroyed the Morella Mining outpost, killing all employees. Sweeps killed 45 Red Hand members including its leaders.

events.title: Arrival in the Csabai system
events.text: The BIAS CCR group left jumpspace and arrived in the Csabai system.

events.title: Starport Alpha
events.text: The BIAS CCR group arrived at Starport Alpha, a starport orbiting the planet Csabai.

events.title: Csabai news roundup
events.text:
source: ss6 news 1105 vol 4

Local reports covered a medical black market boom, an underworld power struggle, smuggling crackdowns, a housing crisis, trade negotiations, an art authenticity dispute, and gala preparations.

events.title: The stolen Beaugart painting
events.text: The BIAS CCR group began investigating the stolen Beaugart painting.

events.title: The Beaugart found
events.text: The BIAS CCR group found the Beaugart and accepted an invitation to the Viscount's ball.

events.title: Augmentation surgery and recovery
events.text: The BIAS CCR group entered a private clinic for augmentation surgery, recovery and physio.

events.title: Youst Refinery deal with Hexham Mining
events.text:
source: ss6 news 1105 vol 5.1

Youst Refining was named sole refinery for all Hexham Mining output.

events.title: Foust Refinery hiring scramble
events.text:
source: ss6 news 1105 vol 5.1

Foust Refinery began tripling its workforce, signing a prisoner work contract with the Ouro Correction department.

events.title: Uplifted apes appear in public
events.text:
source: ss6 news 1105 vol 5

Wu-Ketai confirmed its uplifted apes were "out in the field" with a closed circle of customers, though not yet available to the general public.

events.title: Warning letter to "S"
events.text:
source: ss6 letter 1105 091 a sterlings

A letter warned "S" that a man with a fake smile and missing fingers was asking around town for him.

events.title: Lord Baltimore's intel on Romentino
events.text:
source: ss6 letter 1105 080 lord baltimore

Lord Baltimore reported that Tres had threatened to hand Dr. Smart to the Blackshirts, the Morella outpost was destroyed hours after BIAS CCR left, and the Banks declared war on the Red Hand.

events.title: Nesvorny University ancient research
events.text:
source: ss6 news 1105 vol 6

Nesvorny University scholars presented controversial research linking Ancient civilizations to genetically altered local fauna.

events.title: Calmer Singh and the Irklan assassin
events.text: Released from the clinic, the group waited for a potential client, Calmer Singh, and found themselves embroiled in a mystery. Singh was killed, and his ship held a holo-video about a conspiracy to kill someone named Darnes and to steal the Orb from BIAS CCR. The team killed the Irklan assassin sent after them.

events.title: Who knows about the orb?
events.text: The BIAS CCR group investigated the mystery of Calmer Singh, the dead Irklan, and who knows about their orb. Calmer's crew was found dead in his ship, and the engineer is missing.

events.title: Attack at the Palace
events.text: Asher avoided an attack at the Palace by Housekeeper Tuttle. Beck arranged an appointment with Darnes the following day at LSP.

events.title: Beck enters LSP HQ
events.text: Beck entered LSP HQ on Csabai. Will she ever leave? Sarik and Isambard, with Tina's help, bought information from an Irklan named Reshka: a photo of who hired the Irklan assassin, and word that he is likely in the Psalmist Center in Basin City.

events.title: Marcolandia lifter shortage
events.text:
source: ss6 news 1105 vol 5.1

A shortage of contra-grav lifters hit independent corporations as supply was tied up in exclusive deals.

events.title: The Psalmist Center, Basin City
events.text: Isambard and Sarik went to Basin City and entered the Psalmist Center, where Sarik ended up shooting the man they were looking for, Guillaume.

events.title: Sabrina to perform on Csabai
events.text:
source: ss6 news 1105 vol 5

Kidderminster singing sensation Sabrina planned a series of concerts on Csabai as part of the Duchess Margaret Cultural Exchange Tour.

events.title: Jacob caught; aboard the Raconteur
events.text: The BIAS CCR team hunted down Jacob, who had a data wafer with incriminating evidence. They found him and the wafer, removed the orb references, and turned him over to the authorities. The team left the planet on their new Scout ship, the Raconteur.

events.title: Sanlucar reconstruction hampered
events.text:
source: ss6 news 1105 vol 6

President Weber appealed for interstellar aid as reconstruction was hampered by shortages of heavy construction equipment.

events.title: Psalmist leader behind local crime ring
events.text:
source: ss6 news 1105 vol 6

Authorities arrested three people including Darlene Suitor, head of the Csabai Psalmist Center, over an illegal drug ring.

events.title: Jump to Marcolandia
events.text: The BIAS CCR team arrived at the system's jump point and jumped for Marcolandia.

events.title: Kidderminster stock exchange surge
events.text:
source: ss6 news 1105 vol 6

The Kidderminster Stock Exchange saw record trading volume as speculators bet big on Sanlucar pressure crystal futures.

events.title: Arrival at Marcolandia
events.text: The BIAS CCR team arrived from jumpspace in the Marcolandia system and accepted a job from Foust Refinery to manage security for one week.

events.title: Foust Refinery, day one
events.text: The group set up cameras and interviewed key employees.

events.title: Foust Refinery, day two
events.text: In the evening Foust returned from the capital and fell ill, and a security team released a number of prisoners. BIAS CCR shut down the rebellion and was paid its bonus by their patron, Foust.

events.title: The mysterious ship; jump to Arico
events.text: The BIAS CCR team left the starport and had a strange encounter with a mysterious ship. Isambard and Sarik received mysterious psionic messages. The team jumped to Arico El Nuevo.

events.title: Arrival at Arico El Nuevo
events.text: The BIAS CCR team arrived in the system and set up in the Starport District of Arico El Nuevo.

events.title: Cairo District lynching
events.text:
source: ss6 news 1105 vol 6

An angry mob in Freeport's Cairo district killed Dario Caminante, a man accused of telepathy, amid anti-telepath hysteria.

events.title: Murder in The Lux
events.text:
source: ss6 news 1105 vol 7

Louise Soto, a Wu-Ketai graphic designer, was shot dead by a masked gunman in The Lux in the Humboldt District.

events.title: Psionic treatment and the Lundquist job
events.text: Sarik was treated for his psionic illness. Isambard's is more serious: he needs 700,000 credits. The team took a job for Joanna Lundquist, a Wu-Ketai employee whose husband is missing.

events.title: Undercover on Suliman
events.text: The group arrived at the Suliman asteroid and began their undercover work to find Richard Lundquist. They were attacked by ruffians and arrested, then released with a warning not to cause trouble. They hacked into the security feeds.

events.title: The secret core labs
events.text: The group gained access to the secret core labs and found that George Castle is an employee.

events.title: Chrono-siphoning and the simians
events.text: The group found evidence of chrono-siphoning technology and gave it to their contact for their reward. They fled the asteroid, taking a dozen intelligent simians with them.

events.title: Eternity Station and Reidmar's gambler
events.text: Arriving at Eternity, the team was tasked by Teamster lead Reidmar with finding out how a gambler, Hargon Sargon, was cheating.

events.title: Solon, a murder, and the Demon Princess
events.text: The team pried the gambler's secret from a high-end technology dealer named Solon, earned Reidmar's respect, and learned that Hargon Sargon had been murdered. They solved the murder and met Yandee, the Demon Princess.

events.title: Augment surgery and the slickbays
events.text: The team underwent augment surgery and spent the next seven days in slickbays.

events.title: Sabrina to visit Freeport
events.text:
source: ss6 news 1105 vol 8

Sabrina planned to visit Freeport from 145-1105 for two weeks as part of the Duchess Margaret Cultural Exchange Tour.

events.title: Freeport and attorney Ridpath
events.text: The team arrived at Freeport, met attorney Ridpath, and began the search for Louise Soto's killer.

events.title: Six dead in Cairo violence
events.text:
source: ss6 news 1105 vol 8

Anti-psionic vigilantes stormed a housing project in the Cairo district, lynching a mother and daughter; three vigilantes were killed by authorities. Martial law was declared.

events.title: Sarik kidnapped
events.text: Sarik was kidnapped and rescued.

events.title: Banks post record results
events.text:
source: ss6 news 1105 vol 8

Lenders Montanes Financial and Jollynn Trust posted record profits, while Tagarro Trust missed expectations.

events.title: Reidmar calls a general strike
events.text:
source: ss6 news 1105 vol 8

After the Stratemeyer executions of hostages, Reidmar called a general strike on Eternity Station, halting all ship traffic.

events.title: Hunting Louise Soto's killer
events.text: The team resumed the search for Louise Soto's killer and the connection to Conde Borbon. They heard from Leeluz and headed to the Stardust, then made their way to [[cafe-dimitri|Dimitri's]] and found some dead gangsters. They went to Park 32 to save Starca and found a man with a gun. Sky disarmed him, and they went to meet Winslow Leach, whom they intimidated into handing over his phone.

events.title: The Stardust Gala and the Jollynn raid
events.text: Starca in the bathroom, and a plan to go to the event at the Stardust. At the Gala, Jollynn was leaving. Then the raid on the Jollynn mansion: "Yandee sends her regards."

events.title: Orslo Jollynn murdered
events.text:
source: ss6 news 1105 vol 9

Financier Orslo Jollynn was found murdered at her mansion in a gangland-style execution, revealed to be the clandestine leader of the Stratemeyer Syndicate.

events.title: Downtime at Eternity Station
events.text: Back at Eternity Station, preparing for the trip to [[metropolis-station|Metropolis Station]]: self-improvement, gathering rumours, buying equipment and improving the ship.

events.title: Megacorporation news summary
events.text:
source: ss6 news 1105 vol 9

Hortalez et Cie won a major contract managing the Csabai planetary government's technology solutions, a blow to Ling Standard Products who had held the account for twelve years. On Kidderminster, Hortalez won a military contract for the Kidderminster Navy, beating out Tukera Lines, whose Subsector President is married to Duchess Margaret. On Marcolandia, LSP fought off a Hortalez bid for the Foust refinery and three gas giant mining operations, as LSP pushes for a foothold in super-metal mining from the gas giant Vilnohirsk. On the Arico market, Hortalez rose 7 to 186, LSP fell 1.5 to 141.5, and Tukera Lines fell 5.5 to 97.5.

events.title: Psalmist watch
events.text:
source: ss6 news 1105 vol 9

On Arico, news of Orslo Jollynn's criminal activity bolstered the populist Psalmist community, who cite it as evidence for rejecting the love of celebrity and wealth; Psalmist groups recorded record interest and participation on Freeport and around the Belt, and Arico is seen as the informal center of Psalmist activity in the subsector. On Csabai, Psalmists kept a low profile since the arrest of Darlene Suitor, with local leaders distancing themselves from her group as "an unfortunate militant group that has nothing to do with true Psalmism." On Marcolandia, at least one Psalmist center is closing due to the growing influence of Ling Standard Products, which is known to support organizations limiting Psalmist influence and bars known Psalmists from senior positions.

events.title: Departure for Metropolis Station
events.text: Left for [[metropolis-station|Metropolis Station]].

events.title: Arrival at Metropolis Station
events.text: Arrived at [[metropolis-station|Metropolis Station]]. The crew met the scavenger [[arkady|Arkady]] aboard [[the-bell|The Bell]], learned of the rogue AI [[monarch|Monarch]] and the dangers of diving, and began their first incursions into the station, encountering [[kevyn-barker|Kevyn Barker]] and the stranded diver [[lars|Lars]].

events.title: The filtration hall and the drain room
events.text: The crew scouted the second floor via the ventilation ducts, found the Metropolis Level Two - Filtration Hall and the Metropolis Level Two - Drain Room, and recovered a Revolver with Four Named Bullets inscribed with their own names. They estimated their haul at one to two million credits.

events.title: The Bell, Magnus, and Lord Baltimore
events.text: The crew rested aboard the [[raconteur|Raconteur]] and gathered intelligence from [[the-bell|The Bell]]. [[magnus|Magnus]] pleaded for help retrieving [[lars|Lars]], and [[lord-baltimore|Lord Baltimore]] warned that the Psalmists knew of the [[ancient-orb|Ancient Orb]] and were pursuing them.

events.title: Monarch's bargain and the Eden ghost
events.text: Re-entering under cover of a [[wu-ketai|Wu-Ketai]] sweep, the crew was contacted by [[monarch|Monarch]], who offered a device to deliver to [[commander-kilroy|Commander Kilroy]] in exchange for gifts. They extracted a bag of [[heavy-marbles|Heavy Marbles]], fought synth androids, and recovered the Monarch Advanced Device.

events.title: The meeting with Commander Kilroy
events.text: Aboard [[the-bell|The Bell]], the crew negotiated with [[commander-kilroy|Commander Kilroy]], who demanded their artifacts until [[monarch|Monarch]] was dealt with. They agreed to destroy [[monarch|Monarch]] in exchange for gear and maps, adopted a password, and planned a week of recovery.

events.title: The fourth dive and the Child King
events.text: The crew descended to the second floor, explored the Metropolis Human Emulation Labs, and found a replica of [[isambard|Isambard]]. They deposed the [[child-king|Chosen King]], crossed the Foil Forest, and gained the android [[kira|Kira]] as a guide.

events.title: Final Testing and the goods elevator
events.text: The crew crossed the Final Testing bay and the goods elevator, fought security bots, and escaped to the Loading Dock where [[sky|Sky]] awaited with the [[raconteur|Raconteur]]. [[commander-kilroy|Commander Kilroy]] issued an ultimatum for their artifacts.

events.title: Downtime aboard the Raconteur
events.text: The crew spent a week recovering and monitoring the station. The [[the-134-psalms|Psalmists]] threatened the ship, [[conway|Conway]] proved unhelpful, and [[arkady|Arkady]] reported a Red Shirt Fleet  under the [[duchess-margaret|Duchess]] was inbound.

events.title: The nuclear warhead
events.text: The crew armed the [[nuclear-warhead|Nuclear Warhead]] beneath the station, negotiated safe passage with [[conway|Conway]], and escaped with the [[duchess-margaret|Duchess]]'s cloned body. The warhead detonated, destroying [[metropolis-station|Metropolis Station]] and [[monarch|Monarch]].

events.title: Jollynn murder still unsolved
events.text:
source: ss6 news 1105 vol 10

Authorities made no arrest in the Orslo Jollynn murder, believing professionals hired by a rival drug cartel are off-planet.

events.title: Wu-Ketai faces dual investigations
events.text:
source: ss6 news 1105 vol 10

President David Ives faced pressure from separate Subsector and Imperial investigations into Risiano Tiler's report on illegal experiments on the Suliman Asteroid, weighing on Wu-Ketai and Hortalez share prices.

events.title: Megacorporation news summary
events.text:
source: ss6 news 1105 vol 10

Hortalez et Cie denied knowledge of Wu-Ketai's alleged illegal aging experiments, while Tukera bought an undisclosed block of Hortalez shares, reportedly under pressure from the Imperial governor's office. On Marcolandia, Ling Standard Products finally won controlling interest in a number of refineries. On Kidderminster, Hortalez's banking line became the official financial provider for the Subsector Navy, displacing Tukera Lines. On the Arico market, Hortalez fell 3 to 183, LSP rose 3.5 to 145, and Tukera fell 0.5 to 97.

events.title: Psalmist watch
events.text:
source: ss6 news 1105 vol 10

On Arico, a financial scandal involving a Freeport Psalmist leader cut influence from 5/6 to 4/6, though popularity on Eternity Station held. On Kidderminster, an official Psalmist Center opened, raising influence from 2/6 to 3/6. Formal Psalmist organizations also started on Nesvorny and Sanlucar, raising influence from 1/6 to 2/6.
